## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`uv run pytest -q`)
- [ ] Frontend tests pass (`npm --prefix frontend test`)
- [ ] Production frontend build passes (`npm --prefix frontend run build`)
- [ ] No secret, user data, database, upload, or vector-store artifact is included
- [ ] Visible changes include screenshots or a short recording

## Notes for reviewers

Call out migrations, environment changes, compatibility concerns, or follow-up work.
